hero.subtitle: Proofit reads your resume against a real job description, one requirement at a time, and finds the proof in your classes, projects and part-time work.

marquee.caption: all of it counts as evidence

scene.title: Evidence in.
scene.body: Each line joins something you have done to something the job asks for. Solid lines are proven. Faint lines are partial. Dashed lines are still waiting for evidence.
scene.weightingNote: Proven counts in full. Partial counts half.

how.title: Three steps.
how.intro: From upload to verdict in one pass. Every step shows its work, so you can check it before an employer does.

step1.title: Upload
step1.body: PDF or Word. Classes, projects and part-time roles are read as evidence.

step2.title: Add a job
step2.body: Paste it, or a link, or skip it and match every saved listing.

step3.title: Read the verdict
step3.body: Proven, partial or missing, with the resume line behind each one and a rewrite where you undersell yourself.

why.title: Made for the resume that doesn't have a job title

point1.title: Evidence beyond job titles
point1.body: A database course, a capstone, a weekend support job. Most matching tools score these as zero. Proofit maps each one to the requirement it actually satisfies.

point2.title: Job posts from anywhere
point2.body: Local job boards, company career pages, any post you can paste. If you can read the job, Proofit can read it.

analyze.title: Analyze a job post
analyze.subtitle: Add your resume and the job post. A full analysis usually takes under a minute.

onboarding.title: What Proofit does, and what it will not do
onboarding.line1: It checks your evidence against every requirement in the post, one requirement at a time.
onboarding.line2: It never invents experience. Every suggestion is built only from lines already in your resume.
onboarding.line3: It does not promise to beat any hiring software. It shows you requirement coverage.

results.title: Your requirement coverage

coverage.tooltip: Required items carry more weight than preferred ones, which is why the two figures differ.
coverage.weighting: Weighted: proven = 1, partial = 0.5, missing = 0. Preferred requirements count half.

baseline.caption: A plain word-overlap matcher scored against the same requirements. It compares wording only — it cannot read evidence — so treat its number as a floor, not a second opinion. Its verdicts are the muted labels in the rows below.

results.empty: No requirements were found in this job post. Check the text you pasted and try again.

hiddenStrengths.title: Hidden strengths
hiddenStrengths.intro: These are things you already prove, phrased weakly in your resume. Every suggestion below is built only from lines already there — nothing is invented.

errors.RESUME_BAD_TYPE: This file type isn't supported. Please upload a PDF or DOCX file.
errors.RESUME_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than 5 MB. Try exporting your resume again at a smaller size.
errors.RESUME_UNREADABLE: We couldn't read any text in this file. If it's a scan or a photo, upload a version where the text can be selected — export to PDF from Word or Google Docs.
errors.JOB_EMPTY: We need the job post itself. Paste the job description text, or a link to it.
errors.JOB_URL_BLOCKED: We can't open LinkedIn or Facebook links. Copy the job description text and paste it here instead — that works exactly the same.
errors.JOB_FETCH_FAILED: We couldn't open that link. Copy the job description text and paste it here instead.
errors.ANALYSIS_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find this analysis. Results aren't saved permanently yet — start a new analysis to see fresh results.
errors.ANALYSIS_NOT_READY: This analysis isn't finished yet. Wait for it to complete before asking for rewrite suggestions.
errors.COUNTRY_RULES_NOT_FOUND: We don't have format rules for this destination yet.
errors.ENGINE_FAILED: The analysis didn't finish. Try again — if it keeps failing, send us this error id.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests right now. Wait about a minute and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again — if it keeps happening, send us this error id.

about.title: About Proofit
about.method: Proofit turns the job post and your resume into the same structure, then judges each requirement against your evidence records one at a time. Every verdict cites either the resume line that proves it or an explicit reason nothing matched.
about.limits: Proofit is a study aid, not a hiring decision. It can misread an unusual resume layout or a scanned PDF, it can disagree with a recruiter, and it will never claim experience you do not have.
about.team: Proofit is a final-year project by two students at the American University of Phnom Penh.
about.legality: We read robots.txt before fetching from any job board, we rate-limit our requests, and we store a structured extract with a link back rather than a copy of the post. We never fetch from Facebook or LinkedIn — paste the text instead.
